mathematical_meanings: Left image: The shaded points constitute the solution region on one side of the linear boundary. Right image: The shading selects the planar area left after removing the white triangular cutout.
Rationales: The feature selects the solution half-plane of a linear inequality in the left image and selects a geometric area in the right image. The gray half-plane on the right side of the solid oblique boundary. The single dark polygonal patch sharing the right side of the outer figure.
